title: ACE runtime configuration (.ace.json)
description: Which channels this agent subscribes to and publishes on (RFC §10). Every MQ setting lives here; ACE messages never carry it (RFC §4).

sender.description: Deprecated and unused: a session publishes as "<coding-agent>:<sessionId>", which is also its directory member. Accepted so existing files keep loading; a warning is reported when present.

defaultActivation.description: Fallback activation when neither the subscription nor the message decides (RFC §8).

subscribe.description: Channels this agent receives ACE events from.

publish.description: Channels the ace_publish tool may send ACE events to (RFC §19).

manual.description: Retention limits for manual events (defaults: 100 events, 24h).

registry.description: Agent directory this session registers itself in (RFC §22 item 1); omitted means no registration.

url.description: Broker URL of the directory, e.g. redis://127.0.0.1:6379.

name.description: Channel name: the key its transport is registered under, and the tool's target.

transport.description: Transport kind; the settings below live in `config`.

description.description: Who or what sits on the other end; shown to the model in the ace_publish tool description.

enabled.description: Set false to keep the channel configured but not started.

config.description: Transport-specific settings, validated against the kind.

options.description: Raw options passed through to the transport's client library; not validated.

activation.description: Subscribe only: receiver override for this channel (RFC §8); default delegates to the message.

redisStreamsPublish.description: Append-only target: the publisher needs an address and a field, nothing to read.

field.description: Entry field carrying the ACE JSON, default message.

reclaimIdleMs.description: Claim entries another consumer left pending this long; 0 disables reclaiming. Default 60000.

reclaimAttempts.description: Give up on a reclaimed entry after this many deliveries. Default 3.

retryDelayMs.description: First reconnect delay after a read failure; doubles up to maxRetryDelayMs. Default 200.

maxRetryDelayMs.description: Cap for the reconnect delay. Default 5000.
